cards.lore: He that escapes not without some shaky limb shall acquit him well.
cards.power: THE FALL: Flip a coin. If heads, opponent loses 3 Ribs (HP).

cards.lore: The spirit of my father begins to mutiny against this servitude.
cards.power: SPIRIT OF MY FATHER: Gain +1 Attack for every turn you have been losing.

cards.lore: I had as lief thou didst break his neck as his finger.
cards.power: KINDLE THE BOY: Force target to attack the strongest enemy, not you.

cards.lore: I have lost my teeth in your service.
cards.power: THRIFTY HIRE: Sacrifice this card to fully heal another character.

cards.lore: This our life finds tongues in trees and books in running brooks.
cards.power: SWEET ADVERSITY: Draw two cards whenever you take damage from the environment.

cards.lore: I can suck melancholy out of a song as a weasel sucks eggs.
cards.power: SUCK MELANCHOLY: Drain 1 Action Point from opponent to restore your own Ego.

cards.lore: Sweep on, you fat and greasy citizens.
cards.power: VELVET FRIENDS: If you are losing, your allies abandon you (Discard an ally).

cards.lore: The more pity that fools may not speak wisely what wise men do foolishly.
cards.power: THE WHETSTONE: Confuse enemy; they must speak in rhymes or lose a turn.

cards.lore: We'll have a swashing and a martial outside.
cards.power: COUNTERFEIT MAN: Switch your Strength and Wit stats at will.

cards.lore: I cannot go no further.
cards.power: TRAVELER'S CONTENT: If Ganymede is in play, damage is shared between them.

cards.lore: I am a true laborer: I earn that I eat, get that I wear.
cards.power: TRUE LABORER: Earn 1 gold token per turn.

cards.lore: I must make conclusion of these most strange events.
cards.power: BARRED CONFUSION: End the game immediately; the player with the most pairs wins.

cards.lore: I am invisible; and I will overhear their conference.
cards.power: ILL MET BY MOONLIGHT: Force two opponents to swap active cards.

cards.lore: Methought I was enamour'd of an ass.
cards.power: FANCY'S THRALL: You cannot attack any character designated as 'Beautiful' this turn.

cards.lore: I'll put a girdle round about the earth in forty minutes.
cards.power: LORD WHAT FOOLS: Randomize all targets for the next attack.

cards.lore: She never had so sweet a changeling.
cards.power: JEALOUSY: Cause a dispute; enemy loses 1 turn arguing over custody.

cards.lore: I see their knavery: this is to make an ass of me.
cards.power: TRANSLATED: +5 Confidence, -10 Intelligence. Immune to insults.

cards.lore: He hath played on his prologue like a child on a recorder.
cards.power: PROLOGUE: Read the flavor text aloud; if you stumble, lose 1 HP.

cards.lore: I am no such thing: I am a man as other men are.
cards.power: GENTLE ROAR: Intimidate check; if failed, reveal you are not a lion and deal 0 damage.

cards.lore: Through Wall's chink, poor souls, they are content to whisper.
cards.power: VILE WALL: Blocks all attacks, but allows whispering (passing cards) through the chink.

cards.lore: Use me but as your spaniel, spurn me, strike me.
cards.power: SPANIEL'S FAWN: The more you attack her, the more she buffs you.

cards.lore: Though she be but little, she is fierce.
cards.power: VIXEN: Bonus damage against taller opponents.

cards.lore: The juice of it on sleeping eye-lids said.
cards.power: CUPID'S FLOWER: Attach to any card; that card must defend the next card played, regardless of team.

cards.lore: This dog, my dog.
cards.power: WANING: All moon effects end at the end of the turn.

cards.lore: I will live a bachelor.
cards.power: PAPER BULLETS: Deal damage based on the number of words in your insult.

cards.lore: I had rather hear my dog bark at a crow than a man swear he loves me.
cards.power: KILL HIM WITH WIT: Opponent must discard a card or suffer 'Burn' damage.

cards.lore: I am a plain-dealing villain.
cards.power: CANKER IN A HEDGE: Create a 'Rumor' token that prevents two characters from teaming up.

cards.lore: I have drunk to-day.
cards.power: TALE OF A VILE ENCOUNTER: Fabricate evidence; Swap a player's hand with the discard pile.

cards.lore: O that I had been writ down an ass!
cards.power: WRITTEN DOWN ASS: You cannot fail a roll, you can only succeed at the wrong task.

cards.lore: A good old man, sir; he will be talking.
cards.power: GOOD OLD MAN: Support Dogberry; adds +1 confusion to the board.

cards.lore: One Hero died defiled, but I do live.
cards.power: DIE TO LIVE: Remove from play for 1 round; return fully healed.

cards.lore: Let her awhile be secretly kept in.
cards.power: STRANGE COURSE: Convert 'Slander' damage into 'Guilt' damage on the attacker.

cards.lore: I am your husband, if you like of me.
cards.power: WHICH IS WHICH?: Opponent attacks a random target (could be themselves).

cards.lore: Done to death by slanderous tongues.
cards.power: HANG AN EPITAPH: Lose a turn to mourn; gain +2 attack next turn.

cards.lore: You are a villain; I jest not.
cards.power: WIT CRACKED: Benedick challenges Claudio; loser discards their weapon.

cards.lore: There was a star danced, and under that was I born.
cards.power: MERRY WAR: Resolve the game with a draw if both players are smiling.

cards.lore: Peace? I hate the word, as I hate hell, all Montagues, and thee.
cards.power: FIRE-EYED FURY: First Strike. If attacked, deal damage back instantly.

cards.lore: Ask for me to-morrow, and you shall find me a grave man.
cards.power: PLAGUE ON BOTH HOUSES: When killed, inflict permanent damage on ALL players.

cards.lore: Put up your swords; you know not what you do.
cards.power: PART FOOLS: Cancel combat for one turn.

cards.lore: Do you bite your thumb at us, sir?
cards.power: CIVIL BRAWL: Provoke an enemy; they MUST attack you next turn.

cards.lore: O, I am fortune's fool!
cards.power: FORTUNE'S FOOL: High risk roll: Either double damage or kill self.

cards.lore: It is too rash, too unadvised, too sudden.
cards.power: TOO RASH, TOO SUDDEN: Accelerate the game timer by 2 rounds.

cards.lore: Lord, how my head aches!
cards.power: ANCIENT DAMNATION: Delay delivery of a message/item by 1 turn.

cards.lore: I am the drudge and toil in your delight.
cards.power: HIGH TOP-GALLANT: Sneak into the enemy base (deployment zone) without fighting.

cards.lore: My poverty, but not my will, consents.
cards.power: 40 DUCATS: Buy 'Instant Death' poison for 40 gold (or all your HP).

cards.lore: No warmth, no breath, shall testify thou livest.
cards.power: COLD AND DROWSY: Appear dead for 2 turns (immune to damage), then wake up.

cards.lore: This is thy sheath; there rust, and let me die.
cards.power: SHEATH: Self-sacrifice to end the game on your own terms.

cards.lore: Poor sacrifices of our enmity!
cards.power: GLOOMING PEACE: The game ends. Nobody wins. Everyone feels sad.
NO CLOCK: Time limits removed. Wrestling moves do double damage.
DREAM LOGIC: At start of turn, swap hands with player to your left.
EAVESDROPPING: Look at top card of opponent's deck before they draw.
ROTTEN LUCK: All healing effects are reversed (healing deals damage).
PROOF OF VALOR: Gain +2 Charisma.
MOONSHINE: Reveal invisible units (or Fairies).
MISTAKEN IDENTITY: Redirect a targeted attack to an adjacent card.
DRINK ME: Game Over for that card.
